title: Parisian Love
summary: Google's 2009 'Search Stories' ad, shown in the Super Bowl, tells the story of an American who falls in love in Paris entirely through search queries.
why: HN cites it as a model of emotional product storytelling and as inspiration for visualizing one's own search history as a narrative.

quote.text: Google's famous ad, "Parisian Love", worth watching for those who haven't seen it yet
